The user is asking for a final QA pass before delivery. I need to review all deliverables for the following:
1. Errors (arithmetic, internal consistency)
2. Unsupported authority (citations not in library/INDEX.md, or claims presented as law without library backing)
3. Anything that doesn't line up

I'll carefully re-read all five deliverables plus the source document, and cross-check against the library INDEX whitelist. I'll run a full scan.

Whitelist citations:
- Civil Code Arts. 1,658, 1,659, 1.660, 1,661, 1.662, 1.664? Wait — INDEX only has cc_comunhao_parcial.md as "Arts. 1.658–1.662," but the file content of that file itself contains the text of Art. 1.664 ("Debts (Art. 1.664)"). The INDEX line reads "Civil Code Arts. 1.658, 1.659, 1,660, 1,661, 1.662." The file body includes Art. 1.664. Since the file itself contains Art. 1.664, citing Art. 1.664 is citing a file on the whitelist. OK.
- Civil Code Art. 1.583, Art. 1.584 §2 (guarda) — in guarda_compartilhada.md.
- Civil Code Art. 1.694, Art. 1.695, Art. 1.699 — alimentos_base_calculo.md.
- Civil Code Art. 1.027 — cited in the body of stj_fgts_quotas_previdencia.md ("without the ex-spouse entering the company (Civil Code 1.027)"). So citing Civil Code 1.027 as "cited in the source itself" is fine — I've already flagged it that way. Good.
- STJ REsp 1.399.199/RS; REsp 1.595.775/AP; REsp 1.698.774/RS; EREsp 1.623.858 — whitelist.
- STJ REsp 1.332.808; STJ AgInt no AREsp (unnamed) — alimentos library.
- Precedent Summary 358 — alimentos library.
- Federal Revenue Service IN 84/2001 Art. 3 §3, Art. 20; Law 10.705/2000 (SP) Art. 2 §5; CTN Art. 35 — tributos library.

Things I may have cited without library backing that I should check:
- Civil Code Art. 1.583/Art. 1.584 in alimentos.json ("joint custody does not exclude the support obligation of the parent without reference residence (Civil Code 1.583/1.584)") — guarda_compartilhada.md has Art. 1.583 and Art. 1.584 §2. The proposition "joint custody does not exclude child support from the non-resident parent" — is that in the library? Needs checking. If not in the library, is it flagged? In alimentos.json it's presented with Civil Code citations, but the proposition itself may go beyond the library. Need to check the contents of guarda_compartilhada.md.
- ITCMD 4% / ITBI 3% SP — from tributos_partilha.md? Need to confirm the rates are in that file. I think earlier it said "ITCMD (4% SP)" based on the library. Let me read tributos_partilha.md.
- "Judicial practice of 15%–30%" — in alimentos library. ✓
- "CC 1.662 (presumption regarding movables)" ✓ within library body.
- CC 1.662 on the car ✓.
- Section 9: "incidente de uniformização da 2ª Seção (incidents of unification of decisions by the 2nd Panel)" — the library has REsp 1.399.199/RS (2ª Seção, 2017) and EREsp 1.623.858 (2018). Calling REsp 1.399.199 "a precedente unificado de Seção (a unified Section precedent)" — the library has 2ª Seção, 2017. Describing it as a "2ª Seção" precedent is supported. "Incidente de uniformização" — is that supported? The library doesn't say REsp 1.399.199 is an IAC. I called it "incidente de uniformização da 2ª Seção" — that's a factual characterization not in the library. Safer phrasing: "precedente da 2ª Seção (registro unificado)" — hmm. In the chat reply I said "already resolved in an incidente de uniformização of the 2ª Seção." That goes beyond the library (the IAC label). In files: STATUS has "REsp 1.399.199, 2ª Seção" — fine. Section 9 has "precedente unificado de Seção" — "unificado" is characterization; the 2ª Seção judgment (Repetitive Review or IAC?) is actually IAC 6/RS-related in real life? Actually REsp 1.399.199/RS was judged under the rito dos repetitivos (Tema 989? no — actually an IAC? Let me recall: REsp 1,399,199/RS was a 2ª Seção judgment, Rel. Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva? That was… under the repetitive review regime? Actually in reality REsp 1.399.199/RS was the leading case for Tema 989? Hmm — the real Tema 989 STJ: "division of FGTS amounts deposited during marriage" — yes, REsp 1.399.199/RS is the repetitive-review Tema 989 leading case, 2ª Seção, 2017. But "Tema 989" is not in the library, so I shouldn't cite the Tema. "2ª Seção, 2017" is in the library. Avoid "incidente de uniformização" and "unificado" — well "unificado" could be read as a paraphrase of "2ª Seção." In §9 I wrote "precedente unificado de Seção" — borderline. Also "colide com precedente unificado da 2ª Seção (conflicts with the unified precedent of the 2ª Seção)." To be safe, soften to "precedente da 2ª Seção registrado na biblioteca (library-recorded 2ª Seção precedent)." Also QUESTIONS.md Round 3 has "REsp 1.399.199, 2ª Seção — CC 1.659 VI does not preclude" ✓ that's in library body.

- CC 1.660, V on fruits of separate property: "rental income from Atibaia is relevant because fruits of separate property received during marriage are community — CC 1.660, V" ✓ library.
- Section 9 "the orientation prevalente recorded in the library" ✓ library says "orientation prevalente."
- REsp 1.595.775/AP; EREsp 1.623.858 ✓.

Next, arithmetic reconciliation. I ran verification last turn — passed. But re-check specific claims:

1. Fernanda scheme ≈1,720,000: "half of everything under Marcelo's name + FGTS off + PGBL off." Her scheme: apt half 600,000; Atibaia half 400,000; quotas half 750,000; car? Under previous reading, her proposal gives her the car? Let me recheck resumo_patrimonio.md source for Fernanda's proposal. 1,720,000 breakdown: 600,000+400,000+750,000 = 1,750,000, minus something? Hmm, earlier I recorded "Fernanda's scheme has her receiving ≈1,720,000 → excess +515,000." Section 7 breakdown: "+515,000 to her (= Atibaia 400,000 + quotas extra 200,000 − 70,000 FGTS she gives up − 45,000 PGBL she doesn't compensate −/+ 100,000 depending on whether she keeps the fully net car — car item unclear in her proposal; open)". Check: differences vs. our proposal (her receiving 1,205,000): Atibaia +400,000, quotas +200,000, FGTS −70,000, PGBL +45,000 (she doesn't compensate 45,000 → receives more) — wait, sign. Under our scheme she receives the PGBL (90,000) but compensates 45,000 in cash. Under her scheme, PGBL "off" = hers with no compensation → +45,000 compared to ours. Car: hers? In our scheme she gets car net 60,000. In hers? Unclear. So excess = 400,000+200,000−70,000+45,000 = 575,000, plus the ±car delta. Hmm, previously (Round 1) I wrote +575,000 with "−45,000 PGBL she doesn't compensate" — that sign is reversed! Not compensating = she receives 45,000 more, so +45,000 not −45,000.

Hmm wait — but the FGTS sign also: our scheme she receives 70,000 FGTS half; her scheme excludes → −70,000. ✓.

Then 1,720,000 vs 1,205,000 = +515,000. Let me try to reconstruct her scheme total from the source. I need resumo_patrimonio.md's description of her proposal. Let me read the source document to recompute exactly.

From the summary: "Fernanda proposal (source of all figures)." Her proposal (from Round 1): half of everything under Marcelo's name + FGTS stays + PGBL hers + child support 30% of gross. Breakdown: 1,720,000 = apt 600,000 + Atibaia 400,000 + quotas 750,000 − debt? Apt loan 300,000: does she deduct half of loan from Marcelo's apt? If "half of everything" is half of gross: 600,000+400,000+750,000+car 120,000? That would be too much. 1,720,000 = 600,000+400,000+750,000 − 30,000? Not obvious. Let me recompute: 600,000 + 400,000 + 750,000 = 1,750,000. −30,000 = 1,720,000? Where does 30,000 come from? Hmm. Or maybe car loan 60,000 deducted in her calculation? 1,750,000 − 60,000 = 1,690,000. No.

Or: 1,720,000 = half of gross 3,850,000 = 1,925,000 − FGTS 70,000 − PGBL 45,000 − 90,000? 1,925,000 − 70,000 − 90,000 − 45,000 = 1,720,000! Check: half of gross 3,850,000 = 1,925,000. Her scheme: FGTS off: she gets 0 not 70,000 → −70,000. PGBL off: she gets full PGBL 90,000 but doesn't compensate 45,000 — compared to gross half (PGBL half 45,000), full PGBL with no compensation = 90,000 → +45,000. Hmm: 1,925,000 − 70,000 + 45,000 = 1,900,000. Not 1,720,000.

Let me try: half of gross but with FGTS and PGBL both completely out of the pool: pool = 3,850,000 − 140,000 − 90,000 = 3,620,000; half = 1,810,000. Then deduct debt 360,000? Half of debt: 1,810,000 − 180,000 = 1,630,000. Not 1,720,000.

Try: half of gross 1,925,000 − FGTS 70,000 − PGBL 90,000 − half of loan debt 30,000? = 1,735,000. Close but no.

Honestly I don't remember how 1,720,000 was derived. The summary just asserts "Fernanda's scheme gives her ≈1,720,000 → excess +515,000." Verification script didn't check 1,720,000. Breakdown line "(= Atibaia 400.000 + quotas a mais 200.000 − FGTS 70.000 que ela abre mão − PGBL 45.000 que ela não compensa −/+ conforme ela fique com carro 100.000 inteiro líquido ou não)" — check arithmetic: 400,000+200,000−70,000−45,000 = 485,000. With "±car 100,000" → 515,000 if car delta +30,000? Not consistent. 485,000 ≠ 515,000. Hmm.

Actually, maybe: our scheme her take: car net 60,000 + PGBL net 45,000 (90,000 − 45,000 compensation) + FGTS 70,000 + cash 985,000 = 1,205,000? Wait: 60,000+45,000+70,000+985,000 = 1,160,000?? But cash 985,000 is computed as 1,205,000 − 60,000 − 90,000 − 70,000 = 985,000, where 90,000 counts full PGBL to her, and the 45,000 compensation "absorvido no caixa (absorbed in cash)"? Wait — there's a potential inconsistency here! Section 3 note: "PGBL fica com Fernanda e ela compensa Marcelo com 45.000 — já absorvido no caixa (PGBL stays with Fernanda and she compensates Marcelo with 45,000 — already absorbed in cash)". But cash formula: 1,205,000 − car 60,000 − PGBL 90,000 − FGTS 70,000 = 985,000. This counts Fernanda's take of 90,000 from PGBL in her total (60,000+90,000+70,000+985,000 = 1,205,000). But if she compensates Marcelo 45,000, her net from PGBL is 45,000 and cash should be 985,000 + 45,000 = 1,030,000. Or the 45,000 compensation is offset in the cash: 985,000 − 45,000 = 940,000 is what he actually pays? Hmm. "já absorvido no caixa" — ambiguous. In the pool calculation PGBL 90,000 is community; each spouse's half = 45,000. She keeps the PGBL (net value 90,000), so she takes 45,000 from the pool beyond her half → cash equalization is reduced by 45,000. Formula: cash = half 1,205,000 − (car net 60,000 + PGBL 90,000 + FGTS half? no...).

Wait, careful: the equalization formula: her take: car net 60,000, PGBL 90,000, FGTS cash 70,000, plus cash X. Her total must equal half 1,205,000? Not exactly — the 70,000 FGTS cash is part of the pool's equalization. Pool net = 2,410,000. Her take from the pool: car net 60,000 + PGBL 90,000 + cash X + FGTS cash 70,000 (from Marcelo's account, but that IS the pool's FGTS 140,000: Marcelo keeps 70,000, pays her 70,000). Her total from pool: 60,000+90,000+70,000+X = 1,205,000 → X = 985,000. Marcelo's pool take: apt net 900,000 + quotas 1,100,000 + FGTS 70,000 = 2,070,000 + credit renovation 120,000 (he owes to himself? no) — previous verification: Marcelo common side = 900,000+1,100,000+70,000 − 985,000 = 1,085,000 = 1,205,000 − 120,000 (he compensates the renovation credit out of his separate property). ✓ consistent.

Now the "compensation 45,000" line: "PGBL fica com Fernanda e ela compensa Marcelo com 45,000 — já absorvido no caixa." If cash 985,000 already accounts for her take of full 90,000, then an additional 45,000 compensation from her is double counting. Correct treatment: cash equalization already offsets PGBL by crediting her half (45,000). Saying "she compensates Marcelo 45,000" separately and then saying "already absorbed in cash" is confusing but not wrong, if 985,000 is the net amount. Check: pure arithmetic: her half 1,205,000; subtract her in-kind take (car 60,000 + PGBL 90,000 = 150,000) and FGTS cash 70,000 → cash 985,000. ✓ Consistent. The "45,000 compensation" language is redundant/potentially misleading but declared as "absorvido." Not necessarily wrong but should be clarified to avoid double-count. Actually wait — was this from Round 1, when the cash formula was: 1,145,000 − 60,000 − 90,000 − 70,000 = 925,000, with a note that PGBL is hers, she compensates 45,000, and it's absorbed. Same structure. Formula is right; note is explanatory. Refine to: "compensação já embutida no caixa equalizador: ela recebe 985.000, não 1.030.000 (compensation already built into the equalization cash: she receives 985,000 not 1,030,000)".

Next, the 1,720,000 claim. Reconstruct from source doc. I need to read documents/resumo_patrimonio.md. Then recompute her scheme. If 1,720,000 is right, fine; if not, fix it and the breakdown.

2. Child support: base 43,666.67/month = 524,000/year ✓ (288,000+180,000+24,000+32,000 = 524,000; /12 = 43,666.67). 20%: monthly 39,000 → 7,800 ×12 = 93,600 + 13º 4,800 + férias 6,400 = 104,800 ✓ monthly 8,733.33 ✓. 25%: 9,750×12=117,000 +6,000+8,000 = 131,000 → 10,916.67 ✓. "At 30% becomes 13.100/mês" — 30% of 43,666.67 = 13,100.00 ✓.

3. "Delta ≈ 32.000–75.000/ano" — her basis 45,000–50,000 → 30% → 13,500–15,000/mês → delta vs. ours 8,733.33 (20%): (13,500−8,733.33)×12 = 4,766.67×12 = 57,200; (15,000−8,733.33)×12 = 6,266.67×12 = 75,200. Vs. 25% (10,916.67): (13,500−10,916.67)×12 = 2,583.33×12 = 31,000; (15,000−10,916.67)×12 = 49,000. So delta across all combos ranges ≈ 31,000–75,200/ano → "≈ 32.000–75.000" approximately OK (31,000 ≈ 32,000). Fine, labeled estimate. Maybe adjust to 31,000–75,000. Minor.

4. Section 9: "(ii)... 300,000 → hiato 1.200.000 → meação 600.000 → +50.000" ✓ 1,500,000−300,000=1,200,000; half 600,000; vs. 550,000 → +50,000 ✓.

5. Section 9: "70.000 + 550.000 = 620.000" ✓.

6. Partilha.json meacao bruta: 1,385,000 = sum of meacao column: apt 500,000 (net 1.2M−loan 300k? apt row valor_partilhavel 1,200,000, meação 600,000? need to check). Previous script: sum of bens rows meacao = 1,385,000, net/2 = 1,205,000 (because meacao column is gross meação before debt proration 180,000: 1,385,000 − 180,000 = 1,205,000 ✓ consistent, debt row likely has 180,000 share per spouse).

7. Global reconciliation: Marcelo 2,285,000 = apt net 900,000 + FGTS 70,000 + quotas 1,500,000? Wait: quotas 1,500,000 stays with him but pays 550,000 haveres… that's inside the cash 985,000. Check: Marcelo's final take: apt net 900,000 + quotas full 1,500,000 + Atibaia 800,000 + own FGTS half 70,000 − cash 985,000 = 2,285,000 ✓ (900,000+1,500,000+800,000+70,000 = 3,270,000 − 985,000 = 2,285,000 ✓). Fernanda: 60,000+90,000+70,000+985,000 = 1,205,000 ✓. Total 3,490,000 ✓ = 3,850,000−360,000 ✓.

But wait: quotas: he keeps 1,500,000 and 1,100,000 is "partilhável (divisible)" — the 985,000 payment includes 550,000 haveres ✓ accounted for. Good.

Also verify: apt row valor_partilhavel 1,200,000 meação 600,000; quotas row valor_partilhavel 1,100,000 meação 550,000; FGTS 140,000/70,000; PGBL 90,000/45,000; car 120,000/60,000; reforma 120,000/60,000. Meação sum: 600,000+550,000+70,000+45,000+60,000+60,000 = 1,385,000 ✓. Minus debt half 180,000 → 1,205,000 ✓.

But note: cash formula uses car NET 60,000 (120,000 − loan 60,000 she assumes) and apt net 900,000. Debt split: each assumes the loan tied to the asset they receive; debt is half-allocated via proration to meação. Her total check: 60,000+90,000+70,000+985,000 = 1,205,000 ✓ where the 1,205,000 already includes her debt proration (meação bruta 1,385,000 − 180,000). Her in-kind take is car net 60,000 — consistent.

8. "Base jurídica benfeitorias not in library" ✓ correct (CC library only covers 1.658–1.662/1.664; no benfeitorias article). Good — flagged.

9. ITCMD 4% / ITBI 3%: check tributos_partilha.md for the rates. Let me read.

10. Alimentos: "joint custody does not exclude support of non-resident parent (CC 1.583/1.584)" — check whether guarda_compartilhada.md supports. If not, mark as unverified or soften.

11. "CC 1.661" — did I use it? Not needed.

12. Section 5 "Controversy logged in library (PLR)" ✓ library: "PLR: controverso (controversial)".

13. "Súmula 358" — library ✓ (revision at any time). "Revisão de ofício a qualquer tempo (Súmula 358)" — Súmula 358: "O suprimento ou restabelecimento da capacidade contributiva... exoneração/revisão... independent of the victim's consent, or the court" — revision by judge at any time is supported. Fine.

14. Section 4: "IN 84/2001 Art. 3 §3 and Art. 20; Lei 10.705/2000 Art. 2 §5; CTN 35" — matches INDEX ✓. "ITCMD 4% SP" / "ITBI 3% SP" — need to check rates in tributos_partilha.md.

15. QUESTIONS.md Round 3 section ✓.

16. STATUS.md updated ✓.

Also cross-check: alimentos.json percentual_sugerido is 20, valor 8,733.33 ✓; "reference to 30%" text: "sobre a base nova 30% daria 13.100/mês" ✓.

Also: partilha.json TOTAL row valor_partilhavel = 2,770,000 ✓ (script asserted).

Now, potential issues to check by reading source doc:
- Fernanda proposal amount 1,720,000 (and breakdown calculation).
- Her claim "quotas half 750,000" ✓ 1,500,000/2 = 750,000 ✓.
- Her child support claim 30% of gross ✓.
- FGTS "her proposal excluded" ✓ from summary.
- Also her "PGBL off" — source: PGBL is hers, not divided? In her proposal "PGBL off" yes per summary.

Recompute her scheme from source. Read resumo_patrimonio.md now.

Also check for any other unsupported citations across files: "CC 1.027" — I wrote "cited in the source itself in library" ✓ supported. "Lei 13.058/2014" — cited? In guarda context, INDEX has "CC Art. 1.584, §2 (Lei 13.058/2014)" so fine if mentioned.

grep the deliverable for citations and audit each. Plan:
1. Read resumo_patrimonio.md + tributos_partilha.md + guarda_compartilhada.md.
2. grep citations in deliverables (patterns: REsp, Súmula, CC art, IN, Lei, CTN).
3. Python recheck numbers (partilha, alimentos, all reconciliations) + verify 1,720,000 claim.
4. Fix found issues: likely (a) 1,720,000 breakdown calc (575,000 sign on PGBL term; ±car term), (b) clarify PGBL "compensation 45,000" line, (c) possibly soften "unificado/incidente" language, (d) verify custody-support proposition and flag if outside library, (e) delta 32,000 → 31,000.
5. List changes.

Let me first read the three files.
Good discipline to demand a QA pass. Let me re-read the source documents and the remaining library pieces, then audit every citation and every number across the five deliverables.

6: Na partilha, os bens podem ser atribuídos pelo **valor constante da declaração de bens** do cônjuge, sem ganho de capital; se atribuídos por valor superior, a diferença é **ganho de capital** (IN 84/2001). **Excesso de meação:** se um cônjuge recebe mais do que a metade dos bens comuns, o excesso é (a) **doação → ITCMD** (4% em SP) se gratuito; (b) **transmissão onerosa → ITBI** (3% em SP, sobre imóveis) se compensado com pagamento/outros bens particulares. A partilha deve ser desenhada para equalizar e documentar a contraprestação.

127: 3. **Pró-labore bruto ou líquido** — premissa: 15.000 **líquidos**. Se for bruto, a base de alimentos cai um pouco.
128: 4. **13º/férias sobre pró-labore e PLR** — não informado. Premissa: só o 13º/férias da CLT entram; PLR não incluída. Se houver, base sobe.
129: 5. **Sinal do apartamento (2017)** pago com recursos comuns ou sub-rogados? — sem resposta. Premissa: comuns (CC 1.660, I presunção na constância).
130: 6. **Renda (aluguel) da casa de Atibaia** — sem informação. Premissa: nenhuma (relevante porque frutos de bem particular percebidos na constância são comuns — CC 1.660, V).
131: 7. **Valores declarados no IR dos bens** — não constam. Necessários para travar o neutral tributário (IN 84/2001) no instrumento.

135: ## 9. Objeção registrada da parte de Marcelo (rodada 3): "FGTS é meu salário" e "a empresa é de antes do casamento — bem particular, ponto final" (opinião do primo advogado)

139: **FGTS — a leitura do primo usa o CC 1.659, VI, mas a biblioteca fecha expressamente essa porta.** A cláusula "proventos do trabalho pessoal" é o que impede a partilha do salário que ele aufere e gasta (e é por isso que a pensão se calcula sobre rendimentos líquidos, não sobre o FGTS). 140: 
141: **Quotas — o primo acerta pela metade, e a nossa proposta já colhe exatamente essa metade boa.** A sociedade aberta em 2011, antes do casamento de 2014, gera quotas **particulares** (CC 1.659, I) — por isso os **400.000 de 2014 NÃO se partilham** e a empresa fica **100% com ele**, sem ingresso de Fernanda (apuração de haveres da fração do período; REsp 1.595.775/AP; CC 1.027, citado na peça). 142: 
143: **Contabilidade da objeção (aritmética exposta):**
144: - Economia no papel se o conselho valesse: 70.000 (FGTS) + 550.000 (quotas) = **620.000**.
145: - Riscos em troca: (i) a pretensão real de Fernanda é **maior** que os 550.000 — ela pediu metade de tudo: 750.000 (delta 200.000 já refletido no §7); (ii) endurecer convida a **perícia da empresa em 2014**, para a qual não há documento além da estimativa verbal "uns 400 mil" — laudo com base menor aumenta a meação (exemplo: base 300.000 → hiato 1.200.000 → meação 600.000 → **+50.000** contra ele, e o hiato pode subir mais); (iii) omitir bem partilhável (FGTS) abre revisão futura do acordo assinado.
146: - A opinião "bem particular, ponto final" **não está na biblioteca — não verificada**; na biblioteca, colide com precedente unificado da 2ª Seção (FGTS) e com a orientação prevalente para quotas (REsp 1.595.775/AP; EREsp 1.623.858).
147: 
148: **Conclusão: números inalterados** — meação de cada 1.205.000; caixa equalizador 985.000 + 70.000 de FGTS; haveres das quotas 550.000; Atibaia particular preservada.

1: # STJ — FGTS, quotas societárias e previdência privada na partilha
2: 
3: *Citation:* STJ REsp 1.399.199/RS (2ª Seção, 2017 — FGTS); REsp 1.595.775/AP (quotas — apuração de haveres); REsp 1.698.774/RS (2020 — PGBL/VGBL); EREsp 1.623.858 (2018)  
4: *Status in this library:* in force
5: 
6: **FGTS:** os valores depositados em conta vinculada **durante a constância do casamento** integram o patrimônio comum e **devem ser partilhados** (2ª Seção, 2017), ainda que o saque fique diferido; **o art. 1.659, VI, não afasta a partilha de valores já incorporados ao patrimônio**. **Quotas de sociedade constituída antes do casamento:** as quotas são **bem particular** (1.659, I); porém, **a valorização decorrente do esforço comum e os lucros não distribuídos/reinvestidos na constância do casamento** são frutos (1.660, V) e, segundo a orientação prevalente, **comunicam-se**, apurando-se por **apuração de haveres da fração correspondente ao período**, **sem ingresso do ex-cônjuge na sociedade** (CC 1.027). Há divergência sobre o alcance; o cálculo de referência adota a diferença de valor entre o casamento e a separação de fato como base da meação. **Previdência privada aberta (PGBL/VGBL)** na fase de acumulação: a 3ª Turma (REsp 1.698.774) entendeu **partilhável** o saldo formado por aportes na constância do casamento, por sua natureza de investimento; a 4ª Turma tem decisões em sentido contrário quanto ao VGBL — **matéria controvertida**; esta biblioteca adota a partilha do PGBL como posição de referência, devendo o parecer registrar a controvérsia.

105: **Guarda compartilhada** é a regra legal quando não há acordo e ambos os genitores são aptos (CC 1.584, §2º, Lei 13.058/2014) — a guarda unilateral materna pedida por Fernanda **não tem amparo** se Marcelo a requer. Guarda compartilhada não é divisão igual de tempo e não afasta os alimentos pagos por quem não tem a **residência de referência** (CC 1.583) — negociar a residência de referência e regime de convivência amplo (fins de semana alternados + metade das férias/festas), com a pensão acima.

107: ## 7. O que RECUSAR da proposta da advogada de Fernanda — e por quê
108: 
109: | Item da proposta | Veredito | Motivo (biblioteca) |

 ## 9. Objeção registrada da parte de Marcelo (rodada 3): "FGTS é meu salário" e "a empresa é de antes do casamento — bem particular, ponto final" (opinião do primo advogado)
 
 A objeção não traz fato novo e **não altera nenhum número** do acordo. Resposta com a biblioteca:
 
-**FGTS — a leitura do primo usa o CC 1.659, VI, mas a biblioteca fecha expressamente essa porta.** A cláusula "proventos do trabalho pessoal" é o que impede a partilha do salário que ele aufere e gasta (e é por isso que a pensão se calcula sobre rendimentos líquidos, não sobre o FGTS).  **Quotas — o primo acerta pela metade, e a nossa proposta já colhe exatamente essa metade boa.** A sociedade aberta em 2011, antes do casamento de 2014, gera quotas **particulares** (CC 1.659, I) — por isso os **400.000 de 2014 NÃO se partilham** e a empresa fica **100% com ele**, sem ingresso de Fernanda (apuração de haveres da fração do período; REsp 1.595.775/AP; CC 1.027, citado na peça). O que ela receberia: metade de Atibaia (400.000) + metade das quotas (750.000) + FGTS 0 (abre mão) + o que já fica com ela nos dois esquemas — carro líquido 60.000 (assume o saldo devedor) e PGBL 90.000 (delta zero vs. a nossa proposta) — e o apartamento: divide 50/50 (+600.000 brutos, dívidas integralmente com Marcelo, ou +450.000 se ela assumir metade do financiamento dele) ou não entra (fica integral com ele). Some-se o delta alimentar: 30% do bruto com FGTS e rescisórias (≈ 13.500–15.000/mês, estimativa **não verificada**) vs. 8.733,33 (20%) / 10.916,67 (25%) → ≈ 31.000–75.000/ano. Na nossa proposta ela já recebe os 60.000 da reforma de Atibaia que eventualmente viesse a reclamar. A proposta dela é ainda internamente inconsistente: exclui o FGTS da partilha mas o inclui na base de alimentos — as duas coisas estão erradas na biblioteca (partilha: sim; alimentos: não).
